posting_date.meaning: date the entry was posted to the patient account (for an eligibility check, the response date)

amount.meaning: magnitude of the entry, always zero or positive; the event family's direction decides whether it raises or lowers the account; 0.00 on documentary entries

line_allowed_amount.meaning: payer-allowed amount of the originating claim line that a charge, accumulator or secondary payment stems from; 0.00 on entries not stemming from a claim line

source_category.meaning: equipment or supply line whose claim produced this entry; none when the entry does not stem from a claim line

source_bill_id.meaning: reference of the originating claim line or shipment line in that category's billing record; empty when source_category is none

responsibility_type.meaning: which component of patient responsibility a charge represents; none on non-charge entries

applied_to_entry_id.meaning: ledger entry this entry settles or reverses (a payment, adjustment or secondary payment points at the charge; a refund points at the payment it returns); empty otherwise

payer_coverage_id.meaning: coverage that paid, for a secondary payment (the secondary coverage record); empty otherwise

payment_method.meaning: how a patient payment or refund moved; none on other entries

payment_reference.meaning: reference the patient quotes for a payment or refund (check number or card confirmation code), copied verbatim; empty otherwise

adjustment_reason.meaning: reason code of an adjustment; none on other entries

benefit_year.meaning: benefit year an accumulator entry belongs to; empty on non-accumulator entries

eligibility_result.meaning: payer eligibility response on an eligibility check; none on other entries

statement_cycle.meaning: ordinal of the patient statement (1 for the first statement showing a charge); 0 on non-statement entries

balance_due.meaning: balance printed on a statement or referred to collections; 0.00 on other entries

coverage_request_id.meaning: primary id of the patient-account request

coverage_id.meaning: coverage account the request concerns (foreign key -> coverage_holdings)

requested_amount.meaning: amount the request concerns (refund amount or plan balance); 0.00 when not applicable

submitted_date.meaning: date the request was received from the patient

created_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS <TZ>, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the identity-verification record (content hash of the patient id)

verified.meaning: whether identity verification passed; once true it never reverts to false

verified_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS <TZ>, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: moment of the most recent verification attempt

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the human-handoff record

reason.meaning: reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS <TZ>, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
